# GreatFrontEnd

> > Comprehensive front end interview preparation platform created by ex-FAANG engineers (Meta, Google) featuring 500+ questions, real-world projects, and system design guides.

GreatFrontEnd offers curated interview prep resources including the GFE 75 essential questions list, company-specific guides for FAANG/tech companies, and hands-on project challenges. Founded by Yangshun Tay and team, the platform covers JavaScript, CSS, React, TypeScript, UI coding, behavioral interviews, and system design using the RADIO framework.

## Key Topics

- Front End Interviews
- JavaScript & TypeScript
- React & UI Components
- System Design (RADIO Framework)
- CSS & Responsive Design
- GFE 75 (Essential Questions)
- FAANG Interview Prep
- Coding Challenges
- UI Coding Questions
- Behavioral Interviews
- Component Building
- Accessibility (ARIA)
- Real-world Projects
- Company Interview Guides (Google, Meta, Amazon, TikTok)

## Getting Started

- [GreatFrontEnd: The great way to prepare for Front End Interviews](https://greatfrontend.com): Homepage: Front end interview prep platform by ex-FAANG engineers
- [Get Started - One-stop to prepare for your Front End Interviews](https://greatfrontend.com/interviews/get-started): Central hub: 500+ questions, prep plans, company guides (Google, Amazon, etc.)
- [About Us](https://greatfrontend.com/about): Mission and team background from ex-FAANG engineers

## Interview Preparation Playbooks

- [Front End Interview Playbook: Everything you need to excel](https://greatfrontend.com/front-end-interview-playbook): Complete interview prep guide: coding, system design, UI, resume tips
- [Quick Start Guide to Front End Interviews - Everything to Know](https://greatfrontend.com/front-end-interview-playbook/introduction): Introduction to FE interview formats and preparation by ex-Meta engineer
- [Front End System Design Playbook: All-in-one Deep Dive](https://greatfrontend.com/front-end-system-design-playbook): Comprehensive system design guide: RADIO framework, 10+ solved questions
- [Front End System Design Playbook Introduction](https://greatfrontend.com/front-end-system-design-playbook/introduction): System design interview guide by ex-FAANG engineers with RADIO framework
- [How to Answer "Tell Me About Yourself" | Behavioral Interviews](https://greatfrontend.com/behavioral-interview-playbook/self-introduction): Guide to self-introduction in interviews by ex-Meta Staff Engineer
- [User Interface Coding Questions | How to prepare](https://greatfrontend.com/front-end-interview-playbook/user-interface): UI coding interview guide: HTML, CSS, JavaScript best practices

## Practice Questions & Challenges

- [500+ Front End Interview Questions and Answers](https://greatfrontend.com/questions): Comprehensive question bank with solutions from ex-FAANG interviewers
- [GFE 75 - 75 Most Important Front End Interview Questions](https://greatfrontend.com/interviews/gfe75): Curated list of 75 essential JavaScript, CSS, and UI coding questions
- [Atlassian Front End Interview Guide](https://greatfrontend.com/interviews/company/atlassian/questions-guides): Atlassian-specific guide: 17 questions on accessibility, JS, and OOP

## Real-World Projects

- [GreatFrontEnd Projects - Real-world project challenges](https://greatfrontend.com/projects): Real-world project challenges designed by ex-FAANG engineers
- [Challenges - Browse 66 Frontend/Fullstack Projects](https://greatfrontend.com/projects/challenges): Browse 66 frontend/fullstack project challenges with difficulty levels
- [Component Tracks](https://greatfrontend.com/projects/tracks): Component library tracks for marketing and e-commerce systems
- [Challenge: FAQ Section](https://greatfrontend.com/projects/challenges/faq-section): Mid-level challenge: Accessible accordion FAQ with ARIA support
- [Challenge: Pricing Page](https://greatfrontend.com/projects/challenges/pricing-page): Mid-level challenge: Build pricing page with navbar, FAQ, testimonials
- [Challenge: Sign in / Sign up](https://greatfrontend.com/projects/challenges/sign-in-sign-up): Mid-level challenge: Authentication flow with form validation
- [Challenge: Billing Plans Section](https://greatfrontend.com/projects/challenges/billing-plans-section): Senior challenge: SaaS billing with subscription management features
